name: Kanojo to Ore to, Koisuru Resort ~Kanojo to Ore to Koibito to. & Koisuru Natsu no Last Resort W Fan Disc~
original_name: 彼女と俺と、恋するリゾート ～彼女と俺と恋人と。＆恋する夏のラストリゾートWファンディスク～
source:
This is the double fandisc for Tototo and Koirizo, taking place a year after Koirizo with the Tototo cast visiting Rosemary Island Resort. There are after stories for all the characters, five 3P scenes (Ayano/Susuki, Tsukushi/Konoka, Yuuko/Chikage, Sango/Konami, Yuuhi/Nagisa) and routes for subcharas Yuuhi and Konami. There’s also a sun-tanned swimsuit patch. Enjoy your summer!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/10/14/october-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Tototo和Koirizo的双影碟，发生在Koirizo与Tototo演员访问迷迭香岛度假村一年后。所有角色都有后续故事，五个3P场景（绫乃/须木、筑紫/Konoka、Yuuko/Chikage、Sango/Konami、Yuuhi/Nagisa）以及副角色Yuuhi和Konami的路线。还有晒黑的泳衣补丁。享受你的夏天！

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/10/14/october-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
